description: Figure 3 is a grouped vertical bar chart titled “Dataset Statistics,” illustrating the distribution of essay prompts across four writing genres—Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository—categorized by whether they belong to “Open-Ended” (labeled “Open”) or “Constrained” (labeled “Cons.”) sets. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Sample Count,” ranges from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. The horizontal x-axis lists the four genres. For each genre, two adjacent bars are shown: a light blue bar representing the “Open” set and a light pink bar representing the “Cons.” set, with exact sample counts labeled above each bar. In the Argumentative genre, the Open set contains 79 samples and the Cons. set contains 122. In Narrative, Open has 80 and Cons. has 87. In Descriptive, Open has 68 and Cons. has 100. In Expository, Open has 62 and Cons. has 130. A legend in the upper right corner clarifies that light blue corresponds to “Open” and light pink to “Cons.” The chart visually demonstrates that for all four genres, the Constrained set contains more samples than the Open set, with the largest disparity observed in the Expository genre.
